subject: Marketplace listing fees & partner renewals — approval path
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing fees & partner renewals — initial summary

Hi Laura / Vanessa,

Vendor notices coming in for marketplace renewals (AWS, Azure, GCP). I pulled the fee schedules from each partner team — attached one-pagers. Short summary:

- AWS: insertion/listing fee increases for FY26; one-time listing fee + optional promotion credits.
- Azure: partner program annual fee due Jan 15; MS is proposing a renewed term with higher co-marketing commitments.
- GCP: invoice for 2025 listing (attached) + a small listing maintenance charge.

We need to decide two things quickly:
1) Which fees to approve from the platform budget vs. partnerships budget (AWS must be paid by end of Q1 to keep our enhanced placement).
2) Whether we pursue any credits or deferrals (Vanessa, can you lead negotiations with MS/GCP?).

Attached: AWS_Marketplace_Insertion_Fee_QL.pdf, Azure_Partner_Terms_2026.docx, GCP_listing_invoice_2025-12.pdf

Goal: get a signed approval and payment plan before Jan 31. Can you confirm the budget owner and next steps?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fees & partner renewals — initial summary

Marcus,

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick finance checklist before we commit cash:

- Estimated FY26 incremental cost (tokenized across product + GA): please break out one-time vs recurring.
- Expected revenue/lead uplift tied to each listing change (any vendor metrics?).
- Preferred payment method & vendor invoice (need ProcureCorp PO flow if > $25k).

Vanessa — assigning you to compile the vendor negotiation asks and any draft SOWs or co-marketing commitments we can hold them to.

Marcus — loop ProcureCorp (our AP vendor) once we have final invoices and the go-ahead. I can pre-approve up to $30k from marketing runway; above that I need Priyom sign-off.

Laura
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Dana Mills <dana.mills@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace — FY26 insertion fee and agreement

Hi Marcus,

Following our Q4 sync: AWS is rolling a new insertion fee structure effective Jan 1, 2026 for higher-visibility placements. I attached the fee schedule and a PowerForm DocuSign link for the updated commercial terms. Highlights:

- One-time insertion fee: $22,500 (placement + promotion bundle)
- Option: 6-month marketing credit of $5k if Redwood commits to a 12-month featured placement.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&token=aws-renewal-2026

Attachment: AWS_Marketplace_Insertion_Fee_QL.pdf

If you can route a PO and sign by Jan 15 we can preserve the current placement slot. Happy to jump on a call to walk through the contract.

Best,
Dana Mills
Marketplace Sales, AWS
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fees & partner renewals — negotiation update

Team,

Quick update after vendor outreach and a couple of negotiation calls:

AWS (Dana): confirmed 1/15 deadline for signed terms. We can secure the $5k marketing credit if we commit to 12 months. My recommendation: accept the insertion fee but negotiate inclusion of a marketing co-fund (aim for $10k total).

Azure (Elena): pushing for full partner-program fee up front. I asked for a 60-day deferral and a marketing deliverable swap (we provide a case study + webinar instead of a cash uplift). Awaiting reply.

GCP (Kenji): invoice is for a prior listing maintenance; they are willing to consolidate invoices and offer a small credit on future placement if we commit to a GCP showcase next quarter.

Proposed routing:
- Pay AWS insertion fee from marketing runway (Laura can pre-approve up to $30k).
- Defer Azure fee negotiation; target non-cash offset (case study/webinar) to avoid immediate cash hit.
- Pay GCP invoice via ProcureCorp AP flow (low amount).

If Priyom signs off, finance (Laura) can request ProcureCorp to issue the AWS PO and route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Marking this approved.

Summary: I reviewed the recommendations — accept AWS insertion fee to protect placement and marketing exposure (take the $5k AWS credit; Vanessa please continue to push for the $10k co-fund). Defer cash payment for Azure while Vanessa finalizes non-cash offset. ProcureCorp, please proceed with the following:

- Issue PO for AWS insertion fee (one-time $22,500) to AWS; route payment per DocuSign link once invoice is received.
- Process GCP listing invoice via AP (invoice attached previously).

Laura: you have authority to charge the marketing runway for AWS up to $30k. Please confirm when the PO is raised so we can close the DocuSign.

Marcus / Vanessa: circle back with the final DocuSign link and PR/marketing plan.

Priyom Das
